name: Wintersprig

basic_attack.effect: Deal 2 damage. Flow (0/3): Attack again. Inflict Frozen for each hit.

flow_mechanic: Flow (0/3) = charges up over 3 plays, then triggers 'attack again' bonus
build_fit: Skip for Magic Action Arcanist. Flow requires 3 activations to pay off and Frozen is anti-synergy with chain build.
notes: Could be strong in a dedicated Frost build. Not for our Arcanist.
